. Johnson, who appeared pro-choice to her audience, later transformed into a controversial pro-life activist following her witnessing of an abortion procedure.
“One woman’s story has the power to transform a nation,” read an advertisement for the upcoming film. In the advertisement, Johnson depicted the image of the unborn baby as it emerges from its mother’s womb, an image that she stated in the film she will never forget.
According to The New York Times, Johnson described the scene in her debut memoir.
“It’s the tiniest, most precious human being you will ever see. And it felt like God was, like, pulling at my heartstrings, and tapping me on the shoulder and saying, ‘You belong to the truth now,’” an excerpt from the book cited by the Times reads.
